events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Legacy
angles.copy: A true pioneer who redefined the electric guitar. What's your favourite Jimi Hendrix track or performance?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the enduring frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Chrissie Hynde! Her unique voice and songwriting have kept The Pretenders at the forefront for decades. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. Which Oasis track is your ultimate anthem?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how we carry our music.

angles.name: Original iPod
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? The device that changed portable music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the life and music of John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon. What's the John Lennon song that resonates most with you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the iconic John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and vocal talent of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Impact
angles.copy: On the anniversary of his passing, we celebrate the legend that is Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your top pick from the record?
